# Prism dispersion

Splits the image into a full spectrum fanning out from a center, so edges grow rainbow fringes like light through a prism or a cheap lens.

<EffectDemo effect="prism" />

## Usage

```ts
import { EffectComposer } from '@mk7s/xtree/core';
import { prism } from '@mk7s/xtree/effects/prism';

const composer = new EffectComposer(renderer);
composer.setScene(scene, camera);
composer.add(prism({ preset: 'rainbow' }));
renderer.setAnimationLoop(() => composer.render());
```

Every parameter is also a property: `effect.spread = 0.02`. Uniform changes take effect on the next frame without recompiling.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Type    | Default      | Range   | Description                                                          |
| --------- | ------- | ------------ | ------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `spread`  | number  | `0.02`       | 0 – 0.1 | Width of the spectrum at the edge of the frame, as a fraction of it. |
| `center`  | [x, y]  | `[0.5, 0.5]` | 0 – 1   | Where dispersion is zero.                                            |
| `falloff` | number  | `1.5`        | 0.5 – 4 | How quickly the spread grows toward the edges.                       |
| `samples` | integer | `12`         | 3 – 24  | Wavelengths sampled; more give smoother rainbows.                    |
| `amount`  | number  | `1`          | 0 – 1   | Mix between the original and the dispersed image.                    |

Every effect also has `blend` (any of the 26 [blend modes](/reference/shaders#modes)), `opacity` (0–1) and `enabled`.

## Presets

| Preset    | Settings                                     |
| --------- | -------------------------------------------- |
| `rainbow` | `spread: 0.05`, `samples: 20`                |
| `subtle`  | `spread: 0.008`                              |
| `edges`   | `falloff: 3`, `spread: 0.06`                 |
| `crystal` | `spread: 0.035`, `falloff: 1`, `samples: 16` |

Apply one with `prism({ preset: 'name' })` or `effect.applyPreset('name')`; presets start from the defaults.

## Details

- **Family:** Holographic & iridescent · tracked as story X11.4 in the [plan](https://github.com/s4njee/xtree/blob/main/plan.md).
- **Passes:** samples the pass input at other positions, so it starts a new merged pass; following pixel effects join that pass.
- **Masks:** set `effect.mask` to a texture, depth range or selection to limit where it applies; see [masks](/guide/masks).
- **Motion:** Static: nothing animates.
- **Cost:** 91.9 ms added to a 960×540 frame on CI container (SwiftShader software renderer) (2026-10-11). A software renderer: use it to compare effects, not to predict GPU times.
- **Size:** 6.4 KB gzip budget for `@mk7s/xtree/effects/prism`, including the shared effect runtime.
